{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Confirm the deduplication worked
print(f'Number of unique patients after deduplication: {len(df_dedup)}')

# Verify that no patient_id appears more than once
df_dedup_dup_check = df_dedup['patient_id'].duplicated().any()
print(f'Any duplicate patient_id after deduplication? {df_dedup_dup_check}')"}
